title: Define deterministic engine metrics registry and evidence model
goal: Define a strict local registry for engineering-engine metrics, units, evidence provenance, aggregation semantics, safety class and optimization eligibility.
outputs: closed units aggregations sources safety classes and directions
invariants: optimization cannot remove mandatory or prerequisite-closed safety gates
absence or corruption of metrics cannot weaken validation
raw source code and secrets are never stored as optimization evidence
security_properties: recommendations are advisory until separately verified
security and correctness floors outrank throughput optimization
acceptance_tests: unit tests reject optimization of safety/quality floors
unit tests reject unknown enums duplicate IDs source mismatches and non-finite observations

performance_budget.rationale: this layer exists to reduce engine overhead without trading away safety
metrics: ordinary PR validation overhead from metrics collection remains negligible compared with selected checks

rollback.strategy: revert E8 changes while retaining verified E0-E7 behavior

definition_of_done: metric IDs units aggregation and safety classes are machine validated
mandatory safety metrics are explicitly non-optimizable
registry contains no arbitrary executable commands or external telemetry destination
